# cpp-httplib

Vendored unmodified `httplib.h` from upstream v0.18.1:
https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.18.1

SHA256: `f870541e065de607c8a7f64fc8743b475cd1388fff5238afa8841f75dcbf2b89`.
MIT license in `LICENSE.httplib`. HTTPS/OpenSSL and compression are not enabled.
The service is read-only HTTP intended for a trusted isolated camera LAN, not public exposure.
